title: Champions League Chiba result is in: Hiromu Sasaki won (Japan, 22 Nov)
detail: Limitless now lists Chiba with 8,000 players and Hiromu Sasaki as winner. Deck not checked yet. Japan's Aura Seeker set (ME7) is not legal there yet, so it will not show in these results.

title: Price check: no big moves (20%+) on the chase and collection cards
detail: Checked Mew ex 152 (7-day €74.19 vs 30-day €81.47, −9%), Mewtwo ex 151 (−10%), Gengar ex 154 (−2%) and Mega Darkrai ex 116 (+3%, €184.06 vs €178.18). All under the 20% line; slow slide on the 30th Celebration cards continues.

title: Réunion: Miyata Kard Market shows no OP-18 yet; 30th Anniversary ETB sold out
detail: Miyata's homepage lists no OP-18 products or pre-orders. Its Pokémon 30e Anniversaire Elite Trainer Box shows 'Épuisé' (sold out); Règne Delta (ME06) is listed with its 6 Nov date, stock not shown. Sortilèges was not re-checked today.

title: This weekend: Regional Stuttgart, Sat 28 Nov
detail: Next big Pokémon event in the calendar. Results are usually on Limitless by the evening in Europe, which is the night in Mauritius.
